eligibility_text: Pregnant women and lactating mothers for their first living child (a 2022 update added a smaller benefit for a second child if it is a girl). Broadly targeted at socially and economically disadvantaged women — SC/ST, BPL ration card holders, PM-JAY beneficiaries, e-Shram card holders, MGNREGA job card holders, or households with net family income under Rs 8 lakh/year, among other categories. Registration is at an Anganwadi Centre.
benefits: Rs 5,000 in two instalments for the first child, plus a Janani Suraksha Yojana cash incentive after institutional delivery — averaging about Rs 6,000 total. Rs 6,000 (one instalment) for a second child if that child is a girl.
